verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an open-source benchmarking tool for measuring and optimizing deployment performance, explicitly to "test throughput and latency under various load conditions." That is the load-testing guide the story asks for, and it lets engineers check the speed claims for Fast variants, speculative decoding and on-demand deployments themselves. missing for 10: published tokens-per-second or latency figures, concrete benchmark results backing the speed marketing, independent or hands-on corroboration of performance.
